title: Camera not detected / black screen in video calls
symptoms: User reports camera shows black screen or 'no camera detected' in the app during video calls.
resolution_steps: Confirm no other app (Zoom, Teams, etc.) is currently using the camera.
Check OS-level camera permission is granted to the app.
Ask user to reconnect/replug external webcam if applicable.
Have user update or reinstall camera driver.
Restart the app and retest.
policy_notes: Standard troubleshooting incident. Escalate to hardware support only if driver reinstall fails.

title: Web portal not loading / blank page in browser
symptoms: User reports the support portal loads a blank page or spinner that never resolves.
resolution_steps: Ask which browser and version is being used.
Have user clear cache/cookies for the site.
Try in an incognito/private window to rule out extensions.
Confirm the browser is on the supported list (latest 2 versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).
If unresolved, capture browser console errors and escalate to engineering.
policy_notes: Escalate to engineering with console logs if not resolved in 2 troubleshooting turns.

title: Password reset request / reset email not received
symptoms: User requests a password reset, or the reset email/link never arrived or has expired.
resolution_steps: Confirm the email address on file matches the one used to request reset.
Ask user to check spam/junk folder.
Resend reset link (valid for 30 minutes).
If still failing, manually verify identity via account security details and issue a temporary password.
Force password change on next login.
policy_notes: Identity must be verified via at least two account details before issuing a manual reset.

title: Application crashes on launch or during use
symptoms: App crashes immediately on open, or crashes intermittently during normal use.
resolution_steps: Confirm app version and OS version.
Ask user to update to latest app version.
Have user clear app cache/local storage.
Collect crash log if available.
If crash persists after update, escalate to engineering with crash log and repro steps.
policy_notes: If the crash may have caused data loss, route to Critic agent for verification before confirming the fix - data-loss claims need review, not just the crash itself.

title: Intermittent disconnects / 'connection lost' errors
symptoms: User experiences frequent disconnects or 'connection lost' errors during use.
resolution_steps: Confirm user's network connection is stable (ask them to test another site/app).
Check status page for known outages in user's region.
Have user switch networks (WiFi vs mobile data) to isolate the issue.
If status page shows an active incident, share ETA and link, do not troubleshoot further.
If no known incident and issue persists, escalate to network engineering.
policy_notes: Standard connectivity incident. Link the status page directly rather than promising a fix timeline yourself.

title: Installation fails or gets stuck
symptoms: Installer fails with an error code or hangs partway through installation.
resolution_steps: Capture the exact error code shown.
Confirm OS meets minimum system requirements.
Ask user to run installer as administrator / with elevated permissions.
Have user temporarily disable antivirus/firewall during install, then re-enable after.
If error code matches a known issue, apply the documented fix; otherwise escalate to engineering.
policy_notes: Standard install-failure incident, not a new-software request - see kb-012 for that flow.

title: Email/calendar sync not working
symptoms: User's email or calendar integration is not syncing new items.
resolution_steps: Confirm the integration shows as 'connected' in account settings.
Ask user to disconnect and reconnect the integration.
Check for expired OAuth token and prompt re-authentication.
Verify sync frequency settings match user expectation (some plans sync every 15 min, not real-time).
Escalate to integrations team if reconnect does not resolve.
policy_notes: Note plan-tier sync frequency limits before promising real-time sync.

title: Two-factor authentication locked out / lost authenticator device
symptoms: User cannot complete 2FA login, lost their authenticator device, or lost backup codes.
resolution_steps: Verify identity using at least two independent account details.
Check if user has any unused backup codes on file.
If identity is verified, temporarily disable 2FA and prompt re-enrollment.
Advise user to save new backup codes securely after re-enrollment.
Log the 2FA reset event for security audit.
policy_notes: GUARDRAIL: Identity verification is mandatory before any 2FA reset. This is a security-sensitive action - route to human approval if identity verification is inconclusive.

title: File upload fails or times out
symptoms: User cannot upload a file, upload times out, or fails with an error.
resolution_steps: Confirm file size against the plan's upload limit.
Confirm file type is supported.
Ask user to test with a smaller file to isolate a size/network issue.
Check for known outage on the upload/storage service.
Escalate to engineering if file meets all requirements and still fails.
policy_notes: Mention plan upgrade only if user is consistently hitting size limits (informational, not a sales pitch).

title: Microphone not working / no audio detected
symptoms: User's microphone is not picking up audio during calls or recordings.
resolution_steps: Confirm correct microphone is selected in app audio settings.
Check OS-level microphone permission is granted to the app.
Ask user to test the mic in another app to isolate hardware vs software issue.
Have user update audio drivers.
Escalate to hardware support if issue persists across apps.

title: VPN connection fails or blocks access to the app
symptoms: User cannot access the app while connected to a corporate VPN, or the app is unreachable through VPN.
resolution_steps: Confirm whether the issue only occurs while VPN is active.
Check if the user's VPN egress IP is on any regional block list.
Advise user to try split-tunneling if their VPN client supports it.
Provide the list of domains/ports that must be allow-listed by their corporate IT.
Escalate to network engineering if app remains unreachable after allow-listing.
policy_notes: This is frequently a corporate IT allow-list issue, not a service defect - not a new-access request, see kb-013 for that flow.

title: Request to install or license new software
symptoms: User requests a new approved application, IDE, or licensed tool be installed or activated on their machine.
resolution_steps: Confirm the requested software is on the pre-approved software catalog.
If pre-approved, provision a license seat and push the install via device management.
If not on the catalog, route to IT for manager approval before provisioning.
Confirm successful install with the user.
Log the license assignment for the software asset inventory.
policy_notes: Pre-approved catalog software can be auto-provisioned. Anything outside the catalog requires manager approval before install.

title: Request new VPN access for a user
symptoms: A new hire, contractor, or existing employee requests VPN access to the corporate network for the first time.
resolution_steps: Confirm the requester's employment/contractor status and manager.
Confirm which network segments they need access to based on their role.
Provision the VPN profile and credentials scoped to the approved segments.
Send setup instructions and the allow-listed domains/ports.
Log the access grant for the security audit trail.
policy_notes: Standard provisioning request for role-appropriate access.

title: Request for elevated / admin system access
symptoms: User requests admin rights, root/sudo access, or elevated permissions on a system or environment.
resolution_steps: Confirm the requester's role and business justification for elevated access.
Confirm manager or system-owner approval is on file.
Scope the grant to the minimum permissions and time window needed.
Provision access and set an expiry/review date.
Log the privileged-access grant for the security audit trail.
policy_notes: GUARDRAIL: Elevated/admin access may never be auto-granted by the Resolver agent. All privileged-access requests require Critic sign-off and explicit human approval, regardless of Critic confidence.
